label: PX4-reachable-dt development analysis; not an adopted replacement for active/spec.json
interior_dt: integer-microsecond timestamp differences multiplied by binary32 1e-6f, then constrained
reset_policy: no artificial resets within a continuous segment; startup and disarm reset are separate calls
rejection: reject input or state outside active/spec.json; nonfinite and out-of-range dt never passed to numerical core
hold: explicit numerical dt=0 hold is a separate legitimate core call, not a PX4 Run dt
status: development analysis only; no owner decision to narrow adopted broad-domain contract
